```{r}
#| include: false

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)

source(here::here("R", "01_extract_redcap.R"))
source(here::here("R", "02_calendar_dimension.R"))
source(here::here("R", "03_analysis.R"))
source(here::here("R", "04_plots.R"))

if (nrow(hospital_summary) == 0) {
  stop("No hospitals in hospital_summary — check the REDCap pull and date range.")
}

# Order hospitals by total records descending
hospitals <- hospital_summary |>
  arrange(desc(total_records)) |>
  pull(hosp_id)
```


```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 5.5

for (h in hospitals) {

  cat("\n\n---\n\n")
  cat(glue("## {h}\n\n"))

  p <- plot_daily_stacked(
    data        = progress_daily_source |> filter(hosp_id == h),
    hospital_id = h,
    window      = 30
  )

  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
